briefdescription.para: The verbosity levels for test reporting.

detaileddescription.para: The verbosity enumeration defines the available levels of detail for test output produced by the reporting system. These levels control the amount and type of information displayed during test execution, allowing users to tailor the output to their specific requirements.

The level is selected with the --silent, --quiet, and --verbose command-line options; the default is normal. It affects only the console output; the optional output file always receives the full report.

briefdescription.para: C++ header file with declarations for the µTest++ test reporter.

detaileddescription.para: This header provides the declarations for the test reporting facilities used within the µTest++ framework. It defines the verbosity levels, the endl and indent() stream manipulators, and the abstract reporter base class, which accumulates output in a buffer, writes it to the console and to an optional output file, and dispatches the pass/fail results and the session, suite, and subtest events to the concrete reporters (reporter_human and reporter_tap).
The formatting of the values and the comparison expressions is delegated to detail::expression_formatter.
All definitions reside within the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus namespace, ensuring clear separation from user code and minimising the risk of naming conflicts.
The header files are organised within the include/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus folder to maintain a structured and modular codebase.
This file is intended solely for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.
